findings.name: UnpinnedDataset
findings.message: The dataset 'demo@latest' follows the newest data: two runs of the same code can read different data.
findings.fix: Pin a version: use <dataset>@v1 (a released version) instead of @latest, so a run always reads the same data.

findings.name: NodeSharing
findings.message: Step 'train' has its time limit chosen on the run form (the field '<step>-walltime'), which starts at 4 hours because pipeline.py sets no walltime=. A GPU step joins a node that is already running only if that node has the step's limit and a few minutes left, so a limit close to what the step needs shares more often.
findings.fix: Nothing to fix. Choose the time limit on the run form (<step>-walltime). If this step always needs about the same time, put it in walltime= so the form starts with a good default.

findings.name: RefusedArgument
findings.message: step() no longer takes 'hpc_time_limit'. This app was made before the current pipelines. Create it again from the template.
findings.fix: Remove the argument or write it as the message says; step() raises on it when the pipeline is rendered.

findings.name: IdleTimeoutOff
findings.message: Step 'train' turns the idle limit off. A hung step keeps its GPU, and its budget, until the time limit.
findings.fix: Remove idle_timeout=0 to keep the default (a step with no GPU use and no new log line for 20 minutes is ended), or raise it, for example idle_timeout='40m'.
